doc: I16 refinement binding: which real implementation each refined model edge of facts/morph_header.json is compared with, and how the harness calls it. Read by holon/refinement.py. Each edge is compared with its OWN implementation. Go edges run through replay/M2/go/holon_codec_test.go (copied into a scratch copy of morph common/batch), Solidity edges through replay/M2/solidity/HolonCodec.t.sol (in a scratch Foundry project holding morph contracts/). `fields` maps a Header field of the facts to the Go struct field it fills (the Go structs carry no version: Bytes() writes its own version byte); `getters` maps a getter of the facts to the Go method dec_go calls; `abi` is the order and type of the values the Solidity build block stores, as the harness's HolonHeader struct declares them (sequencerSetVerifyHash is absent: the build block stores the constant bytes32(0)).

dec_go.target: common/batch BatchHeaderBytes: validate(), then the getters in the facts' order (BlobCommitHash for blobVersionedHash); a getter that errors after validate() passed is absent

enc_go_v0.target: common/batch BatchHeaderV0{..}.Bytes() with an empty EncodedBytes cache

enc_go_v1.target: common/batch BatchHeaderV1{BatchHeaderV0: .., LastBlockNumber: ..}.Bytes() with empty EncodedBytes caches

enc_sol.target: contracts/l1/rollup/Rollup.sol _commitBatchWithBatchData header build block: header length by version, BatchHeaderCodecV0.store* in the block's order, then BatchHeaderCodecV1.storeLastBlockNumber when version >= 1; the output is the header the block hashes

ok_sol.target: contracts/l1/rollup/Rollup.sol _loadBatchHeader(b) does not revert (through a harness that inherits Rollup)
